description: Source code for EEPROM driver for MB85RCXX series, including configuration, initialization, read/write operations, and device setup using Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_write_protect_set
methods.description: Sets the write protection GPIO pin state.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_translate_address
methods.description: Translates device offset to I2C address and register address.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_remaining_len_in_page
methods.description: Calculates remaining bytes in current page for write/read operations.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEPROM device, configures GPIO and I2C readiness.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_i2c_write
methods.description: Performs I2C write operation to EEPROM.

methods.name: mb85rcxx_get_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the EEPROM device.
